high_level_description: The image shows a poster displayed on a glass window, likely at an entrance or a public space. The poster is titled "The Future Is Watching: BE AWESOME TO THE PAST" and features a graphic of a rock formation with ancient petroglyphs carved into it. The background of the poster has a gradient of warm colors, transitioning from yellow to pink. The text on the poster includes a call to action against archaeological vandalism, with the website "history.utah.gov/stop-archaeological-vandalism" provided for more information. The design credits the artwork to Todd Ackerson and mentions the petroglyphs
